This happens four times: Filtration.lean `hpow` (line 53), `ringChoose_mem_pbwFiltration` (line 94), `dividedPower_mem_pbwFiltration` (line 128), and `ι_pow_mem_pbwFiltration` (Basic.lean line 166).

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but one bound is proved by a roundabout factorial-inverse route ending in an unrestricted simpa, and one degree-one power step is repeated four times instead of being one lemma.
